subject: EgoSocial kickoff - social awareness eval for assistant products
body:
Team,

Kicking off EgoSocial. The gap we're filling: assistant models are terrible at knowing *when* to intervene in a social situation without being disruptive, and nobody internally can even measure that today. Our open-source release gives us 13,500 egocentric video-question pairs derived from Ego4D, plus EgoSoD, the social-thinking-graph method that integrates audio and visual cues to model participants and pick intervention timing.

Goals for the window: (1) dataset regeneration pipeline running on our infra by March 20 - note the codebase is still marked under development, so expect rough edges; (2) EgoSoD baseline numbers on the full benchmark by April 17; (3) eval onboarded into Evalline with a go/no-go review May 15.

Deshawn, please send staffing and the data-tooling plan. Licensing note: Ego4D access is already cleared for research use.

Dmitri
